title: Hot Italian Giardiniera
description: Hot Italian giardiniera made by pickling peppers, jalapeños, cauliflower, and olives in a tangy mixture of vinegar and oil for a crunchy condiment.
ingredients: 1 (5 ounce) jar pimento-stuffed green olives, chopped

steps.text: Place green and red peppers, jalapeños, celery, carrots, onion, and cauliflower in a large bowl. Stir in salt, then fill with enough cold water to cover. Place plastic wrap or aluminum foil over the bowl; refrigerate for 8 hours to overnight.
Drain salty water; rinse vegetables and set aside.

Mix together olives, garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, and black pepper in a medium bowl. Pour in vinegar and olive oil; mix well. Combine with vegetable mixture; cover and refrigerate for 2 days before using.

video.description: This pickled Italian condiment goes perfectly with an Italian beef sandwich. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make her spicy hot Italian giardiniera using jalapeños and crushed red peppers. Using chopped and brined veggies that are submerged and refrigerated in a homemade pickling vinaigrette, the jalapeño and red pepper adds a fiery kick to this tangy recipe. It’s a cheap, fun, and rewarding way to enjoy an Italian favorite topping.
